fix: Use `self.state.borrow()` on this line and on line 438 (NotificationAction arm). Both blocks only read the state, and borrow_mut on a read-only path panics on any re-entrant borrow and misstates intent.

Store `menu: Arc<PlatformMenuCommandModel>` in `TrayRecord` (wrap in `Arc::new` at the create path, line 235, and the update path, line 760). Then replace this clone with `.map(|record| Arc::clone(&record.menu))`. The borrow still ends before `dispatch` runs, which is required because callbacks may re-enter the service. Only the Arc is cloned per tray menu event instead of the whole command model.

`pending` only needs the resource that `complete()` later uses via `created_resource`. Change the field to `RequestRegistry<ApplicationShellRequestId, Option<ShellResource>>`, compute `let resource = created_resource(&operation);` in `enqueue` and call `state.pending.insert(request_id, resource);`. Update `complete()` to match `Ok(resource)` and use `if let Some(resource) = resource`, and update the `stop()` drain pattern to ignore the value. This removes a deep clone of the full operation (including menu snapshots) on every enqueue.

Collect nothing. Remove matching requests in one pass with `state.requests.retain(|request| { if operation_resource(&request.operation) != Some(resource) { return true; } state.pending.remove(&request.request_id); state.completions.push_back(NativeApplicationShellCompletion { request_id: request.request_id, result: Err(ApplicationShellError::StaleResource) }); false });`. The function takes `&mut ShellState`, so the disjoint field borrows are allowed. Completion order stays the same.

The collect exists only to dodge the borrow through the RefMut guard. Use `let state = &mut *self.state.borrow_mut();` and then `state.completions.extend(state.pending.drain().map(|(request_id, _)| NativeApplicationShellCompletion { request_id, result: Err(ApplicationShellError::ApplicationStopped) }));`. The two fields are disjoint, so this compiles without the Vec.
Derive `Debug` as well: `#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]`. All fields (`Arc<Mutex<Vec<NativeApplicationShellOperation>>>`) already implement Debug, and the public test adapter should be inspectable.
Add `#[must_use]` to `apply`. It returns the `NativeApplicationShellCompletion` that the caller must forward to `complete`, and ignoring it silently loses the completion.
